opening.argument: The video presents Schneider Electric's distributor tools as practical support for routine customer and product questions: it identifies tools intended to ensure “customer satisfaction and business success,” directs users to “Use online help chat in the mySchneider App, technical support, technical FAQs, EZ Selectors for effective product selection,” and explains that chat can help with “product selection.” The described functions are ordinary technical and commercial services, including locating the part number a customer needs and accessing FAQs or chat through the company's portal or app. The visible examples reinforce that purpose: one concerns identifying a replacement cover for a QO140M200 load center, while another shows product-selection fields for NQ panelboards. Nothing described involves investment, payment, credential collection, or another deceptive solicitation; the evidence instead shows routine business support and product selection.
